Our food  system is already broken, now the Trump administration is making it worse by prioritizing corporate greed over our health. The administration gutted regulations — and then pushed a USDA reorganization that relocated thousands of workers, disrupting food safety programs.

This hurts family farms that invested in humane practices, while rewarding factory farms and making all our food riskier. We must stand up  protect small farmers, and demand real food safety.
